'''Daylight''' is a horse owned by [[Faile Bashere]].

==Activities==
After the death of her previous horse, [[Swallow]], Faile obtains Daylight. Daylight carries Faile to the various meetings between her husband, [[Perrin Aybara]], and the [[Lord Captain Commander]] of the [[Children of the Light]], [[Galadedrid Damodred]].{{ref/book|13|34}}{{ref/book|13|40}} Daylight also carries Faile into [[Caemlyn]] to meat with Queen [[Elayne Trakand]].{{ref/book|13|47}}
